title: gateway-route-toggle values schema
description: The values shape a consuming chart must provide to use gateway-route-toggle's named templates. A consuming chart may copy this file as its own values.schema.json, or merge these properties into its existing schema.

host.description: Hostname used as both Ingress rule host and HTTPRoute hostname.

pathType.description: Vendor-neutral path-match type. Only Prefix and Exact are supported -- ImplementationSpecific and any other value fails at template-render time (see templates/_helpers.tpl).

parentRefs.description: Passed through verbatim to HTTPRoute's spec.parentRefs -- at least one entry required if httpRoute.enabled is true.
